purpose: Corrections to balance-type names in legacy population rules. Applied at calculation time and noted on every affected cell. Owner group members (config/balance_rules.json) are never aliased; missing owner types stay missing.

CONTDRBL.evidence: CONTDRBL is not an ECB balance type. CONTDBBL is the only type one letter away; in categories 28002/28003 it holds the guarantee amount (mirror of CONTDB) while CONTCR is empty.

CREDIIT.evidence: Misspelling of the CREDIT balance type.

not_balance_types.evidence: Words captured from explanatory sentences in the legacy mapping text (e.g. 'criteria for residence will be applied'); they are not ECB balance types and are dropped from the component list.
